description.text: The King's Reward Pack (王者奖赏包) of Battle Party: Shining Dream is a one-card prize for the winner of a battle party: each box of part one (18 July 2025) and part two (17 October 2025) held one, and at the Battle Party: Shining Dream shop events it went to the top player. Its 24 holo cards all carry the Battle Party: Shining Dream (对战派对 耀梦) logo. They include Victini ex, Chien-Pao ex, Melmetal ex, Meowscarada ex, Skeledirge ex and Quaquaval ex, Radiant Alakazam and Radiant Greninja, Trainers such as Iono, Arven, Ultra Ball and Dark Patch, and basic Fire and Water Energy. They are numbered out of 24.
